activities.activity: Review Refrigerant Energy Conversion architecture allocation
activities.rationale: Confirm the module has a coherent purpose, submodule breakdown, interfaces and component allocation before any procurement work.
acceptanceCriteria: Every submodule has a stated purpose and at least one component candidate.
Interfaces named on the module are carried by the responsible submodule where the design depends on that interface.
No blocker or major architecture issue is attached to the module.

activities.activity: Verify Refrigerant Energy Conversion requirement calculations
activities.rationale: Tie parsed brief requirements to explicit engineering calculations or sanity checks before accepting the design envelope.
acceptanceCriteria: Each linked requirement has a calculation, sanity check or clearly stated deferred validation path.
No linked sanity check is failing.
Warnings have named follow-up calculations or test evidence.

activities.activity: Collect source-backed evidence for Refrigerant Energy Conversion critical components
activities.rationale: Critical component candidates may support architecture review, but BoM cost/manufacturer/MPN claims are blocked until source-backed evidence is admitted.
acceptanceCriteria: Supplier name, manufacturer or equivalent, MPN where applicable, unit cost and source URL/reference are present.
Evidence is explicitly retrieved and admissible under the sourcing admission protocol.
Claimed quantity and component identity match the architecture candidate line.

activities.moduleName: Outdoor Air Interface -> Refrigerant Energy Conversion
activities.activity: Verify refrigerant_loop interface contract
activities.rationale: Outdoor evaporator must connect to compressor and expansion circuit over a closed refrigerant loop.
acceptanceCriteria: Both endpoint modules declare the interface.
At least one submodule carrier is named on each endpoint.
Electrical, thermal, fluid, mechanical or data capacity is validated by the next detailed design pass.

activities.moduleName: Refrigerant Energy Conversion -> Hydronic Heat Delivery
activities.activity: Verify hydronic_loop interface contract
activities.rationale: Condenser heat must transfer into the hydronic delivery loop.
acceptanceCriteria: Both endpoint modules declare the interface.
At least one submodule carrier is named on each endpoint.
Electrical, thermal, fluid, mechanical or data capacity is validated by the next detailed design pass.

activities.moduleName: Control Compute Communication -> Refrigerant Energy Conversion
activities.activity: Verify control_bus interface contract
activities.rationale: Controller must command compressor and expansion valve operation.
acceptanceCriteria: Both endpoint modules declare the interface.
At least one submodule carrier is named on each endpoint.
Electrical, thermal, fluid, mechanical or data capacity is validated by the next detailed design pass.

activities.activity: Verify sensor_bus interface contract
activities.rationale: Controller must receive pressure and temperature feedback for protection and efficiency.
acceptanceCriteria: Both endpoint modules declare the interface.
At least one submodule carrier is named on each endpoint.
Electrical, thermal, fluid, mechanical or data capacity is validated by the next detailed design pass.

activities.activity: Plan evidence for EN-14511
activities.rationale: Heat pump performance test conditions
acceptanceCriteria: Capacity, COP and operating-point test evidence.
blockers: Compliance evidence not yet collected in scratch prototype.

activities.rationale: Refrigerating systems and heat pumps safety
acceptanceCriteria: Refrigerant charge, pressure protection and safety assessment.
blockers: Compliance evidence not yet collected in scratch prototype.

activities.activity: Plan evidence for EN-60335-2-40
activities.rationale: Electrical safety for heat pumps and air conditioners
acceptanceCriteria: Electrical safety, leakage, temperature and abnormal-operation evidence.
blockers: Compliance evidence not yet collected in scratch prototype.

activities.activity: Review risk control for Refrigerant leak or flammability hazard
activities.rationale: Provisional RPN 108; mitigation: Charge limit review, leak detection, ventilation path and ignition-source control.
acceptanceCriteria: Severity, occurrence and detection ratings have been reviewed by a domain owner.
Mitigation is accepted, corrected or converted into a design action.
Any residual high-risk item has an owner before publication.
blockers: Risk evidence not yet reviewed in scratch prototype.
